title: More ways to work with your team and tools in ChatGPT
description: ChatGPT business plans now support shared projects, smarter connectors, and enhanced compliance features to help teams work faster and more securely.
author: Desconocido

title: Measuring the performance of our models on real-world tasks
description: OpenAI introduces GDPval, a new evaluation that measures model performance on real-world economically valuable tasks across 44 occupations.
author: Desconocido

title: Introducing ChatGPT Pulse
description: Today we're releasing a preview of ChatGPT Pulse to Pro users on mobile. Pulse is a new experience where ChatGPT proactively does research to deliver personalized updates based on your chats, feedback, and connected apps like your calendar.
author: Desconocido

title: Transforming the manufacturing industry with ChatGPT
description: By deploying ChatGPT Enterprise, ENEOS Materials transformed operations with faster research, safer plant design, and streamlined HR processes. Over 80% of employees report major workflow improvements, strengthening competitiveness in manufacturing.
author: Desconocido

title: SAP and OpenAI partner to launch sovereign ‘OpenAI for Germany’
description: SAP and OpenAI launch OpenAI for Germany, a 2026 partnership to bring secure, sovereign AI to Germany’s public sector, enabling safe, efficient public services.
author: Desconocido

title: OpenAI, Oracle, and SoftBank expand Stargate with five new AI datacenter sites
description: OpenAI, Oracle, and SoftBank announce five new Stargate AI datacenter sites, accelerating a $500B, 10-gigawatt U.S. infrastructure buildout to power next-generation AI and create tens of thousands of jobs.
author: Desconocido

title: CNA is transforming its newsroom with AI
description: In this Executive Function series from OpenAI, discover how CNA is transforming its newsroom with AI. Editor-in-Chief Walter Fernandez shares insights on AI adoption, culture, and the future of journalism.
author: Desconocido

title: American-made innovation
description: American-made innovation
author: Desconocido

title: Creating a safe, observable AI infrastructure for 1 million classrooms
description: Discover how SchoolAI, built on OpenAI’s GPT-4.1, image generation, and TTS, powers safe, teacher-guided AI tools for 1 million classrooms worldwide—boosting engagement, oversight, and personalized learning.
author: Desconocido

title: OpenAI and NVIDIA announce strategic partnership to deploy 10 gigawatts of NVIDIA systems
description: OpenAI and NVIDIA announce a strategic partnership to deploy 10 gigawatts of AI datacenters powered by NVIDIA systems, with the first phase launching in 2026.
author: Desconocido

title: Detecting and reducing scheming in AI models
description: Apollo Research and OpenAI developed evaluations for hidden misalignment (“scheming”) and found behaviors consistent with scheming in controlled tests across frontier models. The team shared concrete examples and stress tests of an early method to reduce scheming.
author: Desconocido

title: Introducing Stargate UK
description: OpenAI, NVIDIA, and Nscale launch Stargate UK, a sovereign AI infrastructure partnership delivering up to 50,000 GPUs and the UK’s largest supercomputer to power national AI innovation, public services, and economic growth.
author: Desconocido

title: Teen safety, freedom, and privacy
description: Explore OpenAI’s approach to balancing teen safety, freedom, and privacy in AI use.
author: Desconocido

title: Building towards age prediction
description: Learn how OpenAI is building age prediction and parental controls in ChatGPT to create safer, age-appropriate experiences for teens while supporting families with new tools.
author: Desconocido

title: Introducing upgrades to Codex
description: Codex just got faster, more reliable, and better at real-time collaboration and tackling tasks independently anywhere you develop—whether via the terminal, IDE, web, or even your phone.
author: Desconocido

title: How people are using ChatGPT
description: New research from the largest study of ChatGPT use shows how the tool creates economic value through both personal and professional use. Adoption is broadening beyond early users, closing gaps and making AI a part of everyday life.
author: Desconocido

title: Addendum to GPT-5 system card: GPT-5-Codex
description: This addendum to the GPT-5 system card shares a new model: GPT-5-Codex, a version of GPT-5 further optimized for agentic coding in Codex. GPT-5-Codex adjusts its thinking effort more dynamically based on task complexity, responding quickly to simple conversational queries or small tasks, while independently working for longer on more complex tasks.
author: Desconocido

title: Working with US CAISI and UK AISI to build more secure AI systems
description: OpenAI shares progress on the partnership with the US CAISI and UK AISI to strengthen AI safety and security. The collaboration is setting new standards for responsible frontier AI deployment through joint red-teaming, biosecurity safeguards, and agentic system testing.
author: Desconocido

title: Announcing OpenAI Grove
description: Applications are now open for OpenAI Grove, a 5-week founder program designed for individuals at any stage, from pre-idea to product. Participants receive $50K in API credits, early access to AI tools, and hands-on mentorship from the OpenAI team.
author: Desconocido

title: A joint statement from OpenAI and Microsoft
description: OpenAI and Microsoft sign a new MOU, reinforcing their partnership and shared commitment to AI safety and innovation.
author: Desconocido

title: Statement on OpenAI’s Nonprofit and PBC
description: OpenAI reaffirms its nonprofit leadership with a new structure granting equity in its PBC, enabling over $100B in resources to advance safe, beneficial AI for humanity.
author: Desconocido

title: Shipping smarter agents with every new model
description: Discover how SafetyKit leverages OpenAI GPT-5 to enhance content moderation, enforce compliance, and outpace legacy safety systems with greater accuracy .
author: Desconocido

title: A People-First AI Fund: $50M to support nonprofits
description: Applications are now open for OpenAI’s People-First AI Fund, a $50M initiative supporting U.S. nonprofits advancing education, community innovation, and economic opportunity. Apply by October 8, 2025, for unrestricted grants that help communities shape AI for the public good.
author: Desconocido

title: Why language models hallucinate
description: OpenAI’s new research explains why language models hallucinate. The findings show how improved evaluations can enhance AI reliability, honesty, and safety.
author: Desconocido

title: GPT-5 bio bug bounty call
description: OpenAI invites researchers to its Bio Bug Bounty. Test GPT-5’s safety with a universal jailbreak prompt and win up to $25,000.
author: Desconocido

title: OpenAI and Greek Government launch ‘OpenAI for Greece’
description: OpenAI and the Greek Government have launched “OpenAI for Greece” to bring ChatGPT Edu into secondary schools and support responsible AI learning. This partnership aims to boost AI literacy, fuel local start-ups, and drive national economic growth.
author: Desconocido

title: Expanding economic opportunity with AI
description: OpenAI is launching a Jobs Platform and new Certifications to connect workers with jobs, training, and certifications. Learn how we’re expanding economic opportunity and making AI skills more accessible.
author: Desconocido

title: Vijaye Raji to become CTO of Applications with acquisition of Statsig
description: Vijaye Raji will step into a new role as CTO of Applications, reporting to CEO of Applications, Fidji Simo, following the acquisition of Statsig.
author: Desconocido

title: Building more helpful ChatGPT experiences for everyone
description: We’re partnering with experts, strengthening protections for teens with parental controls, and routing sensitive conversations to reasoning models in ChatGPT.
author: Desconocido

title: Introducing gpt-realtime and Realtime API updates
description: We’re releasing a more advanced speech-to-speech model and new API capabilities including MCP server support, image input, and SIP phone calling support.
author: Desconocido
